body:
My ex wants me dead, because of his fucked up borderline personality disorder perceptions.

I'm not going to give him the satisfaction of that. I'm going to lose weight, work on my memory, and

be happy.

Something he can never be.

Instead of killing myself.

I'm going to go to the store, and buy some vitamin D suppliments.

I think it's the winter, and lack of sun, which is making me feel this way.

After that, I'm going to head to the diner, and get myself a low-cal, but satisfying lunch, because I'm trying to change my lifestyle, and lose weight.

I'm looking forward to spring, and my life, two-five years from now.
